title: Metaphoric Compound Nouns and Abstract Conceptual Idioms

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Advanced Hungarian discourse relies heavily on crystallized metaphoric compounds. Physical landmarks (*vízválasztó, sarokkő, mérföldkő*) map onto historical and intellectual developments, while cautionary objects (*kétélű fegyver, zsákutca*) signal peril.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When deploying these idioms, ensure stylistic coherence: do not mix incompatible source domains (*nem szabad képzavart teremteni*).

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: The reforms proved to be a real watershed.
